ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and identify potential cases of fraud
ideas.angle: Data analysis and investigation of Medicaid providers
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How can Medicaid fraud be prevented?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and highlight the need for increased scrutiny of Medicaid providers. By analyzing data and investigating potential cases of fraud, we can identify areas for improvement and prevent future cases of fraud.
